output.title: Data export / GDPR requests
output.content: To request a full export of your account data for GDPR or personal record-keeping purposes, go to Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export. The export is prepared within 30 days and sent as a download link to your account email.

output.title: Two-factor authentication setup
output.content: Enable two-factor authentication from Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator, Authy) and enter the 6-digit code to confirm setup. Save the backup codes shown at the end in a safe place.

output.title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
output.content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

---

**Subject: Re: How to export all my data**

Thank you for your request. We're happy to help you with a full data export for GDPR compliance purposes.

Here's the process:

1. Log in to your account
2. Navigate to **Account Settings > Privacy > Request Data Export**
3. Submit your request

Your data export will be prepared within **30 days** and a download link will be sent to your account's registered email address.

If you have any questions about the process or run into any issues, please don't hesitate to reach out.

---
